In this episode, I sat down with Will Cannon, a serial entrepreneur who’s built multiple profitable software businesses without a technical background. We talked about how he moved from service work into SaaS, what changed once he focused on recurring revenue, and why customer acquisition matters more than the product itself early on.

Will shared how he thinks about spotting opportunities, validating demand before building, and keeping things simple instead of overengineering. We also discussed where software and automation are headed and what actually matters if you want to build something that lasts.
